summary: A value on a fixed range as a half-circle arc, read at a glance, with thresholds that turn it yellow or red and name the level.

props.name: min
props.description: Defaults to Base UI's own Meter minimum (0).

props.name: max
props.description: Defaults to Base UI's own Meter maximum (100).

props.name: label
props.description: Text under the value, and the gauge's accessible name.

props.name: unit
props.description: Reads the value as an amount, `72 GB`, in place of a percentage of the range.

props.name: description
props.description: A line under the gauge, such as `72 of 100 GB used`.

props.name: warning
props.description: The value from which the arc turns yellow and names its level.

props.name: danger
props.description: The value from which the arc turns red and names its level.

props.name: levels
props.description: What each level is called under the gauge, so color is never the only sign of one. Shown only with `warning` or `danger`.

props.name: intent
props.description: What the reading means when no threshold applies. A threshold that is reached takes its place.

props.name: size
props.description: Width of the gauge, with the type scaled to match.

props.name: animated
props.description: The arc sweeping in and the value counting up when it first shows. Turn it off for a gauge that is simply there; reduced motion does the same.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. `merge` folds them in last, so one here replaces the component's own class for the same utility.
